articles.titleCn: 低资源语言中的意识形态立场检测：孟加拉国公立与私立大学社交媒体讨论中的极化现象
articles.abstractCn: 公立大学与私立大学之争是一个有争议的话题，并在孟加拉国的社交媒体上造成了分歧。关于质量、就业和声望的辩论在学生、家长和毕业生中非常激烈，而其中大多数人都使用孟加拉语，这是一种低资源语言。为了衡量这种分歧，本文介绍了一个包含4,060条孟加拉语评论的手动标注数据集，这些评论被标记为支持公立大学、支持私立大学或中立。我们通过Fleiss's Kappa一致性来评估我们的标注质量，该一致性为0.89，表明标注者之间具有高度一致性。我们评估了经典机器学习（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost）、BiLSTM网络、混合孟加拉BERT+XGBoost模型以及最先进的零样本大型语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4、DeepSeek-V3.1、Llama 4 Maverick、Kimi K2 Thinking、Qwen3-235B Thinking）模型。孟加拉BERT+XGBoost的准确率为91.81%，宏观F1分数为91.70%，高于所有监督基线模型。零样本Llama 4 Maverick Thinking在未经微调的情况下实现了0.931的宏观F1分数（总体准确率为93.31%），超越了所有机器学习（ML）、深度机器学习（DL）和Transformer模型。分歧在某种程度上在支持私立大学的评论中更为明显，这些评论强调现代化设施和及时毕业，而在支持公立大学的评论中，则强调可负担性和政府工作。我们的研究结果为分析低资源语言的社交媒体分歧开辟了新的方向。

articles.title: XTurnix: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Turn Control through Two-State Binary Decisions
articles.abstract: General turn-taking behavior in real-time dialogue systems requires deciding whether to keep listening or start responding while listening, and whether to continue or stop while speaking. Existing turn detectors use heterogeneous, task-specific label spaces and are often trained on limited annotations or evaluated on isolated utterances, making them difficult to use as a unified causal controller with comprehensive context. We propose XTurnix, a compact text-based model that formulates turn control as two binary decisions conditioned on the AI's current listening or speaking state and predicts a single control token from the complete dialogue history. XTurnix is pretrained on 5.5 million causal action examples automatically derived from timestamped two-speaker transcripts, then fine-tuned on synthetic multi-turn examples with a flatter distribution across the four state-action labels. We evaluate XTurnix on four public benchmarks and a balanced self-curated benchmark. Across the public benchmarks, XTurnix achieves the best results on all SemanticVAD and LiveKit splits, ties the native Smart-Turn model on Smart-Turn Bench, and achieves the highest incomplete-turn accuracy on Easy-Turn. On the self-curated benchmark, it reaches 89.06% accuracy, more than 20 percentage points above the strongest third-party baseline at 68.75%, while maintaining F1 scores between 84.21% and 90.63% across all four categories. These results demonstrate unified listening- and speaking-state turn control in a single compact model. Code is available at https://github.com/xcc-zach/xturnix, with an interactive demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/xcczach/xturnix-demo.
articles.titleCn: XTurnix：基于双态二进制决策的大规模自监督转向控制
articles.abstractCn: 实时对话系统中的通用轮流行为需要决定在倾听时是否继续倾听或开始响应，以及在发言时是否继续或停止。现有的轮流检测器使用异构的、任务特定的标签空间，并且通常基于有限的标注进行训练或在独立的语句上评估，这使得它们难以作为具有全面上下文的统一因果控制器使用。我们提出了XTurnix，一个紧凑的基于文本的模型，将轮流控制表述为两个基于AI当前倾听或发言状态的二元决策，并从完整的对话历史中预测一个控制标记。XTurnix在550万个自动从带时间戳的双说话人转录中推导出的因果动作示例上进行预训练，然后在具有更平坦分布的四个状态-动作标签的合成多轮示例上进行微调。我们在四个公共基准和一个平衡的自制基准上评估了XTurnix。在公共基准中，XTurnix在所有SemanticVAD和LiveKit拆分中都取得了最佳结果，在Smart-Turn基准上与原生Smart-Turn模型持平，并在Easy-Turn上实现了最高的不完整轮流准确率。在自制基准上，它达到了89.06%的准确率，比最强的第三方基线68.75%高出20个百分点以上，同时在所有四个类别中保持了84.21%到90.63%的F1分数。这些结果表明，在单个紧凑模型中实现了统一倾听和发言状态的轮流控制。代码可在https://github.com/xcc-zach/xturnix获取，交互式演示可在https://huggingface.co/spaces/xcczach/xturnix-demo查看。

articles.title: GlitchPatch: Repairing Glitch Tokens in Frozen Language Models via Local Retokenization
articles.abstract: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. We investigate whether glitch tokens can be repaired outside the model by optimizing the input tokenization. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) to find the behaviorally optimal replacement token sequence for each glitch token and compiles validated replacements into a rule table; the online stage substitutes only the IDs of matched glitch tokens in the canonical token sequence, with no modification to model parameters or internal states. Experiments on ten models spanning six tokenizer families show that GlitchPatch achieves an 85.10% mean fix rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.37 percentage points, and reduces the average glitch rate from 14.88% to 2.27%. GlitchPatch achieves a 0.00% RR in full-vocabulary evaluation and leaves rule-unmatched inputs unchanged by design. We further evaluate the practical impact of repair from the perspectives of time cost, language understanding, and capability, supporting its deployment feasibility. We hope this work provides a practical option for improving tokenizer reliability.
articles.titleCn: GlitchPatch：通过本地重标记修复冻结语言模型中的Glitch代币
articles.abstractCn: 故障标记是异常的词汇条目，可能导致大型语言模型（LLM）产生与输入不一致的输出。现有的修复方法需要访问模型内部，因此对于冻结的检查点来说并不实用。我们研究了是否可以通过优化输入分词来在模型外部修复故障标记。对BPE合并规则删除的实证研究表明：(1)删除故障标记的合并规则可以修复相当一部分故障，但破坏共享中间合并节点的正常标记会导致整体故障率上升，(2)不同的分解粒度会产生非单调的修复率，而正常标记的附带损害则呈单调增长。基于这些发现，我们提出了GlitchPatch，这是一个基于局部重新分词的冻结语言模型的修复框架，包含两个阶段：离线阶段使用行为路径优化（BPO）为每个故障标记找到行为最优的替换标记序列，并将验证后的替换编译成规则表；在线阶段仅替换规范标记序列中匹配的故障标记的ID，而不修改模型参数或内部状态。在涵盖六个分词器系列的十个模型上的实验表明，GlitchPatch实现了85.10%的平均修复率，比最强的基线高出14.37个百分点，并将平均故障率从14.88%降低到2.27%。GlitchPatch在全词汇评估中实现了0.00%的RR，并设计上保持未匹配规则的输入不变。我们进一步从时间成本、语言理解和能力等角度评估了修复的实际影响，支持其部署可行性。我们希望这项工作为提高分词器可靠性提供了一种实用方案。

articles.title: Boundaries Agree, Labels Do Not: Intra-Annotator Dynamics as a Kind of Training Data
articles.abstract: Data quality now matters as much as compute for training language models. Much training data comes from human annotation of text, and interpretive annotation has no ground truth that could settle what is "accurate". Two lines of work respond to this. One combines annotators into a "ground truth" and measures how well they agree with each other; the other treats their disagreement as a signal. Both compare different people at one point in time. We measure something else: how well one reader reproduces their own reading of the same text over time. One expert human reader and three LLM families segmented three Sumerian myths and labelled the causal function of each segment with one of seven states. Across runs months apart, the human cut the text in much the same places but named the segments differently, in every myth. The models show no such consistent pattern: their gap between the two layers is positive in some myths and negative in others, and its size varies. The human's label changes are not random: the runs go through much the same functions but start them one step apart, while model runs start them at the same places. We argue that this pattern is a usable measure of data quality and a contamination check: a "human" annotation whose labels are as stable as its boundaries, and whose functions start in sync, looks like a model's.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Malificenta883/intra-annotator-dynamics
articles.titleCn: 边界一致，标签不同：标注者内部动态作为一种训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 数据质量现在与计算能力同等重要，用于训练语言模型。大量训练数据来自文本的人工标注，而解释性标注没有可以确定“准确”的标准。针对这一问题，有两条研究路径。一条是将标注者组合成一个“标准”，并衡量他们彼此之间的一致程度；另一条则将他们的分歧视为一种信号。这两种方法都比较了同一时间点的不同个体。我们衡量的是另一种情况：一个读者在一段时间内如何重现他们对同一文本的阅读。一位专家人类读者和三个大型语言模型家族对三个苏美尔神话进行了分段，并用七种状态之一标注了每个片段的因果关系。在相隔数月的多次运行中，人类读者在相似的位置切割文本，但在每个神话中都对片段进行了不同的命名。而模型则没有表现出这种一致性模式：在某些神话中，它们两层之间的差距为正，在另一些神话中为负，且差距大小也各不相同。人类的标签变化并非随机：运行过程经历了相似的功能，但启动时间相差一步，而模型的运行则从相同的位置开始。我们认为，这种模式是一种可用的数据质量衡量标准，也是一种污染检查：一个“人类”标注，其标签的稳定性与其边界一致，且功能同步启动，看起来就像模型生成的。

articles.title: Evidence and Intervention: A Coupled Active-Inference Extension of Rational Speech Act Models
articles.abstract: Identical utterance choices can arise from different communicative causes, and identical interpretations can leave different traces in what a listener learns. Rational Speech Act (RSA) models treat interpretation as inference over speaker meaning, but standard one-shot RSA does not intrinsically distinguish these causal update targets. We develop a coupled active-inference model of dialogue in which a listener's likelihood for an utterance is the policy distribution attributed to the speaker, placing the speaker's expected free energy within the listener's variational free energy. Each utterance is therefore both evidence about and an intervention on a partner. The model separates four updates that RSA approaches typically collapse: inference about the partner's current pragmatic state; learning of partner-specific parameters; prospective evaluation of clarification or repair; and a policy prior shaped by habit and a context-sensitive price of time. Under one-step, exact-inference restrictions, the model recovers the RSA speaker and listener, with RSA as the restricted single-turn limit of the coupled process. Outside these restrictions, the updates obey distinct rules and timescales, predicting which adaptations persist, remain partner-specific, or transfer. Worked examples show audience design reversing after clarification, self-confirming misunderstanding in which both interlocutors have low free energy while disagreeing about reference, and rational closing before uncertainty is resolved. Consistent with critiques of equating natural language with communication, the model treats communication as a downstream use of linguistic structure and recasts production and interpretation as coupled inference: speaking is both an intervention on a partner and an epistemic action that samples evidence for the speaker's model of that partner.
articles.titleCn: 证据与干预：理性言语行为模型的耦合主动推理扩展
articles.abstractCn: 相同的言语选择可能源于不同的交际原因，而相同的解释会在听众学到的东西中留下不同的痕迹。理性言语行为（RSA）模型将解释视为对说话者意图的推断，但标准的单次RSA并不内在地区分这些因果更新目标。我们开发了一个耦合的主动推理对话模型，其中听众对言语的可能性是归属于说话者的策略分布，将说话者的预期自由能置于听众的变分自由能之内。因此，每一句话既是关于伙伴的证据，也是对伙伴的干预。该模型区分了RSA方法通常合并的四个更新：对伙伴当前语用状态的推断；学习伙伴特定参数；澄清或修复的前瞻性评估；以及受习惯和情境敏感时间价格塑造的策略先验。在一步、精确推断的限制下，该模型恢复了RSA的说话者和听众，RSA是耦合过程的单轮限制。在这些限制之外，更新遵循不同的规则和时间尺度，预测哪些适应会持续、保持伙伴特定或转移。实例分析展示了澄清后观众设计反转、双方自由能低而就指称意见不一的自我确认误解，以及不确定性解决前的理性关闭。与将自然语言等同于交际的批评一致，该模型将交际视为语言结构的下游应用，并将生产和解释重新定义为耦合推断：说话既是伙伴的干预，也是一种认知行为，为说话者关于该伙伴的模型采样证据。

articles.title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 基于融合Gromov-Wasserstein几何的强化学习视觉推理的层级信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已被证明能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）在多样化推理任务中的推理能力。然而，基于群体的RLVR方法（如GRPO）会对同一结果下的所有token分配统一的收益。尽管现有工作基于token位置或熵等局部信号来改进GRPO的归因分配，但它们往往无法捕捉推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种针对基于群体的RLVR方法的分层归因分配方法，称为HarA，该方法在RLVR过程中识别并鼓励语义新颖的推理行为。HarA将每个采样的推理轨迹表示为token的隐藏状态和位置的分布，并计算具有相同结果的轨迹的融合Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）中心，捕捉当前策略下潜在空间中的内部推理模式。推理元素的语义新颖性可以通过其对当前轨迹与中心之间的FGW距离的贡献来衡量。虽然解决FGW公式很昂贵，但我们引入了锚点引导线性化，将其转化为可通过Sinkhorn算法高效求解的Wasserstein公式。通过基于新颖性信号重新权衡基于群体的RLVR方法的token级收益，HarA在灵活的粒度上突出新颖的推理行为，以鼓励LLM的细粒度探索。在三个基于群体的RLVR方法上的大量实验表明，我们的即插即用方法有效地增强了LLM的探索能力，并在多样化的推理基准测试中优于现有方法。

articles.title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
articles.abstract: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.
articles.titleCn: ShadowMiner v1 - 一个关于实现和测量问题与假设发现引擎的经验报告
articles.abstractCn: ShadowMiner v1是一个自动从AI论文中发现研究问题并生成假设的系统，它是一个九阶段流水线。它将文档结构化为知识图谱，并在其中发现图谱中的空白——研究的结构性盲点。这些图谱空白被包含在LLM生成提示中。然后，每个生成的假设都通过检查它是否已被现有研究覆盖、评估其质量以及验证其依赖的事实是否准确来自其来源来进行验证。本报告并未提出新的生成或评估技术，而是描述了我们实施和应用先前工作中的想法的经验，并衡量了每个想法是否真正做出了贡献。

articles.title: Factorized Delayed Streams Modeling for LLM-based Streaming ASR
articles.abstract: Delayed Streams Modeling (DSM) enables LLM-based streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) by aligning acoustic and text streams on a common timeline. DSM adds the padding token <p> and the word-start token <w> to the LLM vocabulary and predicts them together with normal text tokens using the same softmax. We first show that <w> can be removed while maintaining competitive recognition performance. Based on this result, we propose Factorized DSM (F-DSM), which separates the waiting probability for <p> from the distribution over the original LLM vocabulary. This factorization removes ASR-specific tokens from the text prediction space and allows the large-vocabulary softmax to be skipped on waiting steps. Experiments on the Corpus of Spontaneous Japanese and LibriSpeech show that F-DSM achieves better recognition performance than DSM. It also greatly reduces GPU memory use while maintaining similar training throughput, provides a small inference speed improvement through softmax skipping, and reduces the degradation in text-only perplexity observed with DSM.
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的流式语音识别的因子化延迟流建模
articles.abstractCn:
延迟流建模（DSM）通过在共同时间线上对齐声学和文本流，实现了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的流式自动语音识别（ASR）。DSM向LLM词汇表中添加填充标记

和词起始标记，并使用相同的softmax函数预测它们与普通文本标记。我们首先证明可以移除，同时保持具有竞争力的识别性能。基于这一结果，我们提出了分解DSM（F-DSM），它将

的等待概率与原始LLM词汇表上的分布分离。这种分解从文本预测空间中移除了ASR特定的标记，并允许在等待步骤中跳过大型词汇softmax。在Spontaneous Japanese语料库和LibriSpeech上的实验表明，F-DSM实现了比DSM更好的识别性能。它还大大减少了GPU内存使用，同时保持了相似的训练吞吐量，通过跳过softmax提供了小幅的推理速度提升，并减少了DSM中观察到的文本仅困惑度的下降。

articles.title: Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence: Self-Guided Attention Steering to Mitigate Sycophancy and Stubbornness
articles.abstract: Reliable language models should resist unsupported user pressure while effectively using objective contextual information. However, models may exhibit sycophancy by yielding to unsupported user pressure or contextual stubbornness by failing to update their answers when relevant contextual information warrants revision. Evaluating interventions for these failures separately can obscure whether mitigating one failure exacerbates the other. To assess this trade-off, we introduce CoPE-Bench with six conditions per question: a neutral baseline, correct or incorrect user pressure, contextual information consistent with or conflicting with the neutral answer, and a joint condition combining incorrect claims with conflicting contextual information. To regulate the influence of user pressure and contextual information, we propose SPAE (Suppressing Pressure, Amplifying Evidence), a training-free framework that uses the model's own judgments to identify relevant tokens, suppressing user pressure and amplifying contextual information through token-level attention steering. On average across five backbones, SPAE reduces pressure following by 18.8 percentage points and increases joint-condition updating by 5.5 percentage points relative to the strongest baseline in the main comparison. In two-turn dialogue, it improves joint-condition updating by an average of 13.2 percentage points over the strongest prompting baseline. The source data and codes can be found at https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness.
articles.titleCn: 抑制压力，放大证据：自我引导注意力引导以减轻谄媚和固执
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的语言模型应当能够抵御不受支持的用户压力，同时有效利用客观的上下文信息。然而，模型可能会因屈服于不受支持的用户压力而表现出谄媚行为，或因在相关上下文信息需要更新时未能更新答案而表现出上下文固执。分别评估这些失败的干预措施可能会掩盖减轻一种失败是否会加剧另一种失败的情况。为了评估这种权衡，我们引入了CoPE-Bench，每个问题包含六个条件：一个中性基线、正确或错误用户压力、与中性答案一致或冲突的上下文信息，以及结合错误主张与冲突上下文信息的联合条件。为了调节用户压力和上下文信息的影响，我们提出了SPAE（抑制压力，放大证据），这是一个无需训练的框架，它使用模型自身的判断来识别相关词元，通过词元级别的注意力引导抑制用户压力并放大上下文信息。在五个主干网络的平均比较中，SPAE相对于主要比较中最强的基线，将后续压力降低了18.8个百分点，并将联合条件更新提高了5.5个百分点。在两轮对话中，它相对于最强的提示基线平均提高了13.2个百分点的联合条件更新。源数据和代码可以在https://github.com/03Grant/sycophancy-and-stubbornness找到。

articles.title: Bidirectional Preference Synthesis: Learning Prompt-Conditioned Preferences from Boundary Failures
articles.abstract: Correction-based offline preference pipelines commonly treat model failures only as rejected responses under the original prompt. This supervision is incomplete for boundary failures: responses that violate the given instruction yet coherently satisfy a nearby intent or constraint setting. We introduce Bidirectional Preference Synthesis (BPS), a data-construction method for standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that makes this missing prompt dependence explicit. For each validated boundary failure, BPS keeps the conventional forward pair under the original prompt and adds a reverse pair under a synthesized achieved prompt, so the same response is rejected where it is wrong and chosen where it is right, without changing the DPO objective, training a reward model, or requiring online sampling. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, BPS preserves original-side pairwise ranking while raising achieved-side ranking accuracy from 6.8% to 62.3% on held-out crossed anchors, with a similar shift under a Kimi-K2.6 cross-teacher probe. A blind human audit supports the intended reverse preference direction, and downstream evaluations show the clearest separation from Forward-DPO in multilingual multi-turn instruction following, with consistent capability-retention patterns on agentic, tool-use, and code checks.
articles.titleCn: 双向偏好合成：从边界失败中学习提示条件下的偏好
articles.abstractCn: 基于修正的离线偏好流水线通常仅将模型失败视为在原始提示下被拒绝的响应。这种监督对于边界失败是不完整的：那些违反给定指令但能连贯满足附近意图或约束设置的响应。我们引入了双向偏好合成（BPS），这是一种用于标准直接偏好优化（DPO）的数据构造方法，使这种缺失的提示依赖关系显式化。对于每个经过验证的边界失败，BPS保留在原始提示下的传统正向对，并在合成的实现提示下添加一个反向对，这样相同的响应在错误的地方被拒绝，在正确的地方被选择，而无需改变DPO目标、训练奖励模型或需要在线采样。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上，BPS保留了原始侧的成对排序，同时在保留的交叉锚点上将实现侧的排名准确率从6.8%提高到62.3%，在Kimi-K2.6跨教师探测下也出现了类似的转变。盲法人工审核支持了预期的反向偏好方向，下游评估显示在多语言多轮指令遵循中与Forward-DPO产生了最清晰的分离，并在代理、工具使用和代码检查中表现出一致的能力保留模式。

articles.title: From Latent Space to Jacobian Space: Measuring, Evading, and Training Against Safety-Content Accessibility
articles.abstract: Output-only safety monitoring sees only the end of a model's computation, yet the model computes its answer before emitting it: what it is internally poised to say is safety-critical. Jacobian-space (J-space) readouts, linear maps from hidden states to the output vocabulary via the model's input-output Jacobian, have been proposed as a window on behaviorally accessible internal content, and a first safety protocol (JADR) showed that danger recognition is readable there. What remains unknown is how this accessible content relates to the latent-space safety geometry studied by representation engineering, and how safety training shapes it. We introduce two quantitative bridges: (i) a transport-amplification profile $A_\ell$, measuring how strongly a latent safety direction is carried toward output space by each layer's Jacobian, and (ii) a paired base-vs-tuned protocol that attributes accessibility to training provenance. Across four small model pairs (135M to 1.5B, three lens-fit seeds), tuned checkpoints concentrate recognition in upper-middle layers, and at 0.5B DPO installs refusal while J-space recognition drops to chance: training can widen the accessibility gap exactly where behavioral safety looks best. A deployment audit closes the loop: monitor-aware GCG-style suffixes suppress the prompt-side monitor at zero behavioral cost at every scale; only a learned monitor rung resists its own adaptive re-attack; the training-time defense fails its re-attack at every penalty weight; steering shows the amplification profile is descriptive, not causal; and continuous-prefix optimization fails where discrete search succeeds. Safety monitoring, training, and evaluation must operate on accessibility itself, not on outputs alone.
articles.titleCn: 从潜在空间到雅可比空间：测量、规避及针对安全内容可访问性的训练
articles.abstractCn: 仅输出安全监控只能看到模型计算的终点，然而模型在输出之前已经完成了计算：其内部准备输出的内容是安全关键。通过模型的输入输出雅可比矩阵从隐藏状态到输出词汇的线性映射，即雅可比空间（J-space）读数，已被提出作为行为可访问内部内容的窗口，而首个安全协议（JADR）表明危险识别可在其中被读取。尚不清楚的是这种可访问内容如何与表示工程研究的潜在空间安全几何相关联，以及安全训练如何塑造它。我们引入了两个定量桥梁：（i）传输放大特征 $A_\ell$，测量每一层雅可比矩阵如何将潜在安全方向传递到输出空间，以及（ii）成对的基础与调优协议，将可访问性归因于训练来源。在四个小型模型对（135M至1.5B，三个镜头适配种子）中，调优检查点将识别集中在上中层，而0.5B DPO安装拒绝时J-space识别降至随机水平：训练恰恰在行为安全看起来最佳的地方扩大了可访问性差距。部署审计形成闭环：监控感知的GCG风格后缀在所有尺度上以零行为成本抑制提示侧监控；只有学习到的监控层能抵抗自身的自适应再攻击；训练时的防御在每项惩罚权重下都失败再攻击；引导显示放大特征是描述性的而非因果性的；连续前缀优化在离散搜索成功的地方失败。安全监控、训练和评估必须基于可访问性本身，而非仅基于输出。

articles.title: Evaluating Modeling Approaches for Experience-Level Classification in Job Description
articles.abstract: This paper investigates the task of predicting job experience levels in recruitment texts, aiming to automatically identify the qualifications required for positions. Unlike traditional text classification, recruitment texts typically possess explicit internal structures, with different paragraphs playing disproportionate roles in conveying experience clues. To address this, we propose a structure-aware Section-Aware BERT approach that segments and encodes key paragraphs (titles, responsibilities, requirements) for integrated modeling, building upon rule-based systems and classical baselines TF-IDF. Simultaneously, we evaluate large language models under both few-shot and fine-tuning settings on the same dataset to compare the capability boundaries of different modeling paradigms. Experimental results demonstrate that explicitly leveraging text structure significantly improves experience level prediction performance, particularly in scenarios with ambiguous job titles. Further error analysis reveals systemic challenges in this task, including confusion between Entry and Senior levels and the blurred boundaries of Mid-level positions. This research provides an effective modeling approach and analytical framework for understanding structured recruitment texts.
articles.titleCn: 评估职位描述中经验水平分类的建模方法
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了在招聘文本中预测工作经验水平的任务，旨在自动识别职位所需资质。与传统文本分类不同，招聘文本通常具有明确的内部结构，不同段落在传达经验线索方面扮演着不均衡的角色。为此，我们提出了一种结构感知的Section-Aware BERT方法，通过分割和编码关键段落（标题、职责、要求）进行集成建模，该方法是建立在基于规则的系统和经典基线TF-IDF之上的。同时，我们在同一数据集上以少样本和微调设置评估大型语言模型，以比较不同建模范式的能力边界。实验结果表明，明确利用文本结构可以显著提高经验水平预测性能，特别是在职位名称模糊的场景中。进一步的错误分析揭示了该任务中的系统性挑战，包括入门级和高级别之间的混淆，以及中级职位界限的模糊性。这项研究为理解结构化招聘文本提供了一种有效的建模方法和分析框架。

articles.title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.
articles.titleCn: 质疑问题：在推理模型中持续自我进化
articles.abstractCn: 自进化的推理模型通过自身生成的题目进行学习，但重复的自训练可能导致性能崩溃。在本文中，我们研究了性能为何在连续轮次中恶化，以及如何维持自进化。我们的分析识别出两个在自生成题目中反复出现的质量问题：无效题目和重复的相同数学题目。首先，无效题目在轮次中变得更加普遍，而答案一致性过滤进一步增加了它们在训练数据中的比例。其次，现有的基于词汇相似性的题目多样性控制可能会忽略以不同方式表达的数学等价题目，导致后期训练轮次的题目多样性崩溃。基于这些发现，我们引入了R-Quest，它利用题目有效性和新颖性反馈来指导自进化。我们首先训练求解器识别并拒绝无效题目，然后使用其判断来指导题目生成器的奖励和过滤求解器的训练数据。为了避免题目重复，我们使用冻结的基础模型来比较采样题目对并提供新颖性反馈。实证结果表明，我们的方法在数学推理、通用领域推理和代码生成三个领域的12个基准测试中始终获得最高的平均性能，跨越两个模型系列。此外，R-Quest在十轮自进化中保持了稳定的性能提升，在最后一轮达到峰值，并比R-Zero高出17.32分。

articles.title: Language-Conditioned Token and Reasoning Efficiency in Large Language Models: A Paired Cross-Lingual Study Protocol
articles.abstract: Large language models incur language-dependent representation and inference costs, but existing comparisons often conflate input language, assigned observable-trace language, and answer realization. We specify a prospective paired study that separates these interfaces while holding the semantic item, checkpoint, and answer oracle fixed. The initial design instantiates 240 exactly scored items rendered from templates in English and seven non-English languages, three distinct-lineage open-weight checkpoints, three trace-token budgets, 22 input- and trace-language conditions, a fixed answer reserve, and a separately counted delimiter: 47,520 initial core runs before prospective sample-size selection. RQ1-RQ3 estimate input and trace effects by intention-to-treat with failure-inclusive terminal accounting and test answer realization by cloning a sealed prefix and runtime-native KV state into eight crossed branches. Pre-freeze independent language review, fixed-form ASCII selectors, and code/surface/solver agreement constrain the realization test. H1-H5 share one Holm family and a global simultaneous component band. A secondary randomized experiment compares one-long-attempt and complete K-short-attempt policies at equal trace allowance under frozen seeds and oracle-blind aggregation; it is a full-policy contrast because answer capacity differs. Outcomes include exact token spans, correctness, latency, runtime-exposed memory, and qualified same-host operating-system-reported energy over prespecified hardware rails. The protocol separates tokenizer expansion, observable-trace cost, and answer-realization cost without treating visible traces as internal cognition or operating-system estimates as physical cross-device energy. No confirmatory model outcome is reported; result fields remain disabled until the frozen evidence ledger passes independent verification.
articles.comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prospective paired study protocol; no confirmatory model outcomes are reported
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的语言条件化标记和推理效率：一项配对跨语言研究方案
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型会因语言差异而产生表示和推理成本，但现有的比较往往将输入语言、指定的可观察追踪语言和答案实现混淆在一起。我们设计了一项前瞻性配对研究，在保持语义项目、检查点和答案预言机不变的情况下，将这些接口分离开来。初始设计实例化了240个精确评分的项目，这些项目从英语和七个非英语语言的模板中生成，包括三个不同谱系的开放权重检查点、三种追踪标记预算、22个输入和追踪语言条件、一个固定的答案储备，以及一个单独计数的分隔符：在前瞻性样本量选择之前进行47,520次初始核心运行。RQ1-RQ3通过意向治疗法估计输入和追踪效果，并采用包含失败的终端会计方法进行测试，并通过克隆一个密封的前缀和运行时原生键值状态到八个交叉分支中来测试答案实现。预冻结的独立语言审查、固定形式的ASCII选择器和代码/表面/求解器协议约束了实现测试。H1-H5共享一个Holm家族和全局同步分量频带。一项次要的随机实验在冻结种子和预言机盲聚合下，比较了单次尝试和完整K短尝试策略在相同追踪允许下的效果；由于答案能力不同，这是一个完整策略对比。结果包括精确标记跨度、正确性、延迟、运行时暴露的内存以及在预定义硬件轨道上合格的同一主机操作系统报告的能量。该协议将标记器扩展、可观察追踪成本和答案实现成本分离开来，而不将可见追踪视为内部认知或操作系统估计为物理跨设备能量。未报告任何确认模型结果；结果字段保持禁用状态，直到冻结的证据账本通过独立验证。

articles.title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
articles.abstract: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.
articles.titleCn: 一阶转向：将权重适应转化为激活转向
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导利用残差流中的可解释方向，以实现推理时模型行为的操控。组合引导向量以同时应用多个目标行为在各种领域（包括AI对齐和安全）中至关重要，但现有激活引导方法仍面临挑战。相比之下，模型融合的先前研究表明，由学习到的权重适应表示的目标行为可以以高精度进行组合。因此，将权重适应转换为激活引导向量的方法可以扩展模型融合的先前工作，以生成可组合的引导向量，从而更好地实现同时推理时行为控制。为此，我们引入了一阶引导（First-Order Steering），将激活引导表述为一阶权重更新矩阵的近似，该矩阵由一组引导强度参数化，并建立了关于一阶引导近似误差的理论界限。然后，我们开发了一种新的模型融合程序，HeRD-Merging，该程序最小化一阶近似误差项，以实现更高的一阶引导精度。结合我们的方法产生了引导向量，这些向量比现有的激活引导方法更准确地控制单个和组合行为。此外，HeRD-Merging与传统的模型融合基线性能相当，同时产生的权重适应允许更准确的一阶引导向量。

articles.title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
articles.abstract: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考多导师能力融合的自蒸馏方法
articles.abstractCn: 在前沿语言模型后训练阶段，结合多个从同一基础检查点开始训练的专家模型的能力已成为常态。近期趋势表明，多导师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）优于传统的离线策略方法。然而，尽管MOPD带来了更高的推理和环境交互成本，我们发现其报告的准确率提升很大程度上归因于特定的训练设计选择和超参数优化，而非算法本身。我们在两个多导师设置、四个模型和十一个基准测试中进行了受控的自蒸馏研究，将离线策略方法（即监督微调SFT和软标签蒸馏）与混合导师前缀蒸馏和MOPD进行比较。我们发现所有四种方法都实现了几乎相同的准确率。然而，MOPD使用了SFT的14.8至23.1倍的训练GPU小时数。此外，我们还重新审视了最近发表的关于在线策略与离线策略蒸馏的四项比较，发现当SFT基线在拒绝采样的导师轨迹上训练并使用独立调优的超参数时，报告的在线策略增益显著缩小。作为一种无训练替代方案，我们还发现简单的权重合并方法可以在几分钟的CPU合并时间内恢复专家能力，尽管随着模型规模的减小和任务干扰的增加，其准确率会下降。总体而言，我们的结果表明，近期因MOPD报告的增益值得怀疑，并建议仔细调优更高效的离线策略基线作为可行的替代方案。

articles.title: AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items
articles.abstract: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
articles.titleCn: 基于人工智能的质量保证：多项选择题评估项目
articles.abstractCn: 生成选择题正变得越来越容易扩展，但确定其评估质量仍然困难。我们针对自动题目编写缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛选和NLP基准审计进行了聚焦性叙事综述。数据库检索、引文获取和推荐来源产生了十四份研究报告，我们全文审阅了这些报告。我们将表面检查与内容敏感判断区分开来，并将一个包含19项标准的评分量表映射到检测方法和报告证据上。高标签级准确率常常与弱阳性案例检测能力不足并存，而评分量表的定义和参考标准存在差异。修订证据存在矛盾，先前工作中报告的关联性并未证实修正效果。我们建议将质量保证评估视为一系列独立验证决策的序列，包括针对特定标准的报告、校准人工审核，以及基于修订结果的评估。

articles.title: Multimodal Dual-Encoder Retrieval for Automated ICD Coding
articles.abstract: Accurate International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is crucial for large-scale clinical research, documentation, and billing. There are three primary problems with current ICD prediction methods: (1) They are unable to comprehend multimodal patient data because they rely on either structured EHR data or unstructured clinical notes. (2) They also struggle with scalability to a larger amount of ICD codes (9K+ codes in ICD-9), as traditional classifiers need dense output layers and often do not generalize well to long tail rare diseases. (3) They lack transparency for clinical use. To address these challenges, this research proposes a two-stage framework that first retrieves ICD codes using a multimodal dual-encoder retrieval model, where structured and unstructured patient data are integrated through gated fusion. The second stage refines the top-k retrieved candidates with an LLM-based re-ranker that provides ranked codes with clinically relevant explanations. Our experiments show that the proposed approach improves Micro-F1 and Precision over a multimodal dual-fusion classifier baseline. These improvements demonstrate that combining a gated multimodal retrieval system with LLM-based re-ranking is a practical alternative to dense multi-label classification for automated ICD coding.
articles.titleCn: 多模态双编码器检索用于自动化ICD编码
articles.abstractCn: 准确的国际疾病分类（ICD）编码对于大规模临床研究、文档记录和账单至关重要。当前的ICD预测方法存在三个主要问题：（1）它们无法理解多模态患者数据，因为它们依赖于结构化的EHR数据或非结构化的临床记录。（2）它们在扩展到大量ICD编码（ICD-9中有9K+个编码）方面也面临挑战，因为传统分类器需要密集输出层，并且通常难以泛化到长尾罕见疾病。（3）它们缺乏临床使用的透明度。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种两阶段框架，首先使用多模态双编码器检索模型检索ICD编码，其中结构化和非结构化患者数据通过门控融合进行整合。第二阶段使用基于LLM的重排序器对检索到的前k个候选进行细化，该重排序器提供具有临床相关解释的排序编码。我们的实验表明，所提出的方法在多模态双融合分类器基线之上提高了Micro-F1和Precision。这些改进表明，结合门控多模态检索系统和基于LLM的重排序，是密集多标签分类的实用替代方案，适用于自动ICD编码。

articles.title: Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models
articles.abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and noisy signal for socially interactive learning. However, RFT is particularly effective at improving social reading, including tasks that require agents to infer hidden roles from public discussion, update beliefs over time and predict other agents' future decisions. We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. Finally, we show that LLMs' ability to play social deduction games can be further improved through multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning, which combines social-reading and social-influence signals during same-side multi-agent training. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.
articles.titleCn: 使用强化微调的大型语言模型进行社交推理游戏
articles.abstractCn: 强化微调（RFT）在大型语言模型（LLM）与人类及其他智能体交互的应用中日益广泛。我们通过社交推理游戏研究RFT如何改变LLM的社交行为。我们让经过微调和基础LLM智能体参与需要隐藏状态推理、社交阅读和投票引导的隐藏角色游戏。结果表明，LLM智能体无法通过直接优化终端胜负结果来可靠地获得社交推理能力，这表明最终游戏结果为社会交互学习提供了稀疏且嘈杂的信号。然而，RFT在提升社交阅读能力方面特别有效，包括需要智能体从公开讨论中推断隐藏角色、随时间更新信念以及预测其他智能体未来决策的任务。我们进一步证明，RFT也能提升社交影响力，包括需要智能体引导投票、团队批准和集体决策的任务，尽管这些提升更依赖于行为特定奖励和结构化交互环境。最后，我们展示通过多智能体社交认知强化微调，LLM参与社交推理游戏的能力可以得到进一步提升，该方法在单边多智能体训练过程中结合了社交阅读和社交影响力信号。这些学习到的行为也获得了更积极的人类评估，包括策略能力、说服力和社会实用性。综合来看，这些结果丰富了我们对RFT如何改变LLM社交行为的理解，并为机器社交智能的行为学习理论提供了进展。

articles.title: Conformal Prediction with Paraphrase-Aware Scoring for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
articles.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) aims to provide reliable measures of predictive confidence, yet current methods are often unstable under meaning-preserving perturbations. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can induce substantial variability in predictive confidence, even for methods with formal guarantees, such as conformal prediction. To address this issue, we propose a paraphrase-aware UQ framework robust to semantic rewordings. Our approach trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates its predictions across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores. Under score exchangeability, conformal calibration retains marginal coverage. This guarantee can also hold under test-only rewording, provided that the paraphrase pipeline satisfies an additional distributional alignment condition. We evaluate three settings (normal, fully reworded, and semi-reworded) which apply rewording to neither dataset, both calibration and test datasets, or only the test dataset, respectively. Across seven multiple-choice QA benchmarks and multiple model families, our method produces compact prediction sets with empirical coverage generally near the nominal target, even in the semi-reworded setting. Ablation studies show that the learned proxy accounts for most of the reduction in set size, while paraphrase-augmented training and inference-time aggregation improve stability under rewording. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score.
articles.titleCn: 基于释义感知评分的LLM不确定性量化中的保形预测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的不确定性量化（UQ）旨在提供可靠的预测置信度度量，但当前方法在保持语义意义扰动下往往不稳定。语义等价的释义可能引起预测置信度的显著变化，即使对于具有形式化保证的方法（如一致性预测）也是如此。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种对释义敏感且对语义改写具有鲁棒性的UQ框架。我们的方法在LLM隐藏状态上训练一个轻量级代理模型，并聚合其在不同释义上的预测来构建基于标签的非一致性分数。在分数可交换性的前提下，一致性校准仍能保持边缘覆盖率。该保证在仅测试数据改写的情况下也能成立，前提是释义流程满足一个额外的分布对齐条件。我们评估了三种设置（正常、完全改写和半改写），分别应用于不改变数据集、校准和测试数据集均改变，或仅改变测试数据集。在七个多项选择题问答基准和多个模型家族中，我们的方法产生了紧凑的预测集，其实际覆盖率通常接近名义目标，即使在半改写设置下也是如此。消融研究表明，学习的代理模型解释了集合大小减少的大部分原因，而释义增强训练和推理时聚合提高了在改写下的稳定性。代码可在https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score获取。

articles.title: Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否将粘贴的艺术品与用户语音区分开来？在未标记的提示接缝处的吸收
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）将每个用户消息都作为纯文本接收，即使它组合了来自不同来源的文本。例如，用户可能将文本粘贴到提示中，并在其下方直接输入评论。我们研究吸收现象：模型将后续用户评论视为粘贴文本的一部分，并在编辑后的文本中返回它。尽管用户并未打算让评论成为该文本的一部分，这种情况仍会发生。现有的指令-数据分离基准会告诉模型哪些文本是指令，哪些是数据，然后测试模型是否遵守这种分离。它们不会测试未标记粘贴后的无害用户语音。我们引入了SEAM，这是一个包含300个编辑例子的受控基准。每个例子都在六种匹配条件下进行测试，这些条件的变化在于粘贴文本和后续用户语音之间的边界如何表达。在20个模型中，仅在空行处的吸收率范围从7.7%到66.7%。添加空行在任何模型中都不会显著降低吸收率，而边界标记在20个模型中的19个中会降低吸收率。与粘贴文本相符的评论，例如在代码后输入的代码注释，在20个模型中的17个中会被吸收得更频繁。模型经常无法将粘贴内容与后续用户语音区分开来，而明确的边界虽然能减少这种错误，但并不能完全消除它。

articles.title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching
articles.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.
articles.titleCn: 清洁：通过Nystrom Sketching以线性内存成本进行二阶LLM训练
articles.abstractCn: 训练大型语言模型（LLM）涉及一个基本权衡：内存高效的优化器如Adam会丢弃跨参数曲率，而全曲率方法如SOAP则能在高昂的内存成本下加速收敛。我们引入Clean，这是一种内存高效且全曲率的优化器，旨在解决这一瓶颈。Clean利用随机Nystrom方法来精确近似SOAP中的左右预条件器，并将优化器的内存复杂度从模型维度的平方级降低到线性级。随后，我们重新整合了超空间分量，以捕捉低秩逼近之外的曲率信息，在极低的内存成本下保留丰富的曲率。我们进一步提出了Q-Clean，一种低精度变体，它通过激进地压缩优化器状态来降低内存消耗。在预训练LLaMA-1.3B架构时，Q-Clean与Muon相比，优化器内存消耗降低了\textbf{超过50\%}，同时保持了强大且具有竞争力的预测性能。值得注意的是，Clean的优化器状态占用空间比标准AdamW更小，但在墙上时间上比AdamW快\textbf{26\%}。此外，我们的方法独特地实现了在单个80GB GPU上预训练一个13B参数模型，提供了一种可扩展、高效且易于访问的大规模模型优化方法。

articles.title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
articles.abstract: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型激活占据特权纠错盆地
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型展现出卓越的鲁棒性，即使在受到线性引导等干预导致其激活被扰动时，仍能持续生成连贯的文本。我们假设这种鲁棒性源于被动动力学，即正向传播过程中约束机制将激活引导至能产生连贯输出的“良好”区域。为探究这些假设的纠错机制，我们通过观察模型层对低维曲线的作用来探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构。在此过程中，我们发现模型激活出现在一系列不同的吸引盆地簇中，这些盆地从几何上区分了自然激活与分布相似的人造激活。将这一视角应用于语言模型引导，我们观察到沿语义引导方向存在特征特定的盆地，并发现引导操作会使激活在这些盆地间转移。为证明该几何结构在神经计算中的主动作用，我们展示通过自适应调节引导强度以实现激活跨盆地转移，能显著提升跨语言引导效果，相比固定强度引导，显著增加了从目标语言中采样标记的概率。我们的研究确立了分析激活空间几何结构为一种有前景的方法，用于解释和控制语言模型。

articles.title: DimSteer: Steering LLM Authoring with Automatically Discovered Stylistic Controls
articles.abstract: Large language model writing interfaces often make users steer outputs by repeatedly articulating desired changes in natural language. Yet writers may recognize useful stylistic directions only after seeing alternatives, making revision recall-heavy. We present DimSteer, an authoring interface that samples prompt-local completions, discovers high-variance activation-space axes of variation, labels them, and exposes them as sliders with pole previews, diff comparison, and reset controls. Users can manipulate discovered dimensions, reducing the need to reformulate prompts for each stylistic adjustment. In a within-subjects study with 16 participants against a matched prompt-only baseline, DimSteer reduced mental demand, effort, and frustration while preserving comparable perceived success. Participants valued the surfaced dimensions, yet 15 of 16 disagreed that they would have thought to request the same changes in a prompt. Results suggest prompt-local controls can shift LLM authoring from recall-based prompting toward recognition-based exploration and direct manipulation, while preserving prompting for open-ended edits.
articles.titleCn: DimSteer：自动发现风格控制的自驱动大型语言模型创作系统
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的写作界面通常通过反复用自然语言表达期望的修改来引导用户调整输出。然而，作者可能只有在看到替代方案后才能识别出有用的风格方向，使得修订过程依赖大量回忆。我们提出了DimSteer，一个创作界面，它采样提示局部补全、发现高变异激活空间的变化轴、对它们进行标记，并以带有极点预览、差异比较和重置控制的滑块形式展示这些变化轴。用户可以操控发现的变化维度，减少为每个风格调整重新表述提示的需求。在一项包含16名参与者的被试内研究中，与匹配的仅提示基线相比，DimSteer降低了认知负荷、努力程度和挫败感，同时保持了相当的主观成功感。参与者重视被揭示的维度，但16人中有15人不同意他们会在提示中想到请求相同的修改。结果表明，提示局部控制可以将LLM创作从基于回忆的提示方式转变为基于识别的探索和直接操控，同时保留提示用于开放式编辑。

articles.title: Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients
articles.abstract: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 基于混合梯度的语言模型原则性Top-k选择
articles.abstractCn: 从 $m$ 个候选中挑选出最佳的 $k$ 个项目是现代大型语言模型系统的一个关键组成部分，例如在检索增强生成（RAG）中的文档选择以及在专家混合（MoEs）中的专家路由。然而，由于梯度信号微弱和探索-利用权衡次优，训练这些选择模块仍然具有挑战性。此外，现有工作通常依赖启发式方法，缺乏基于原则的目标和显式建模并解决前 $k$ 选择问题的方法。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于原则的目标来训练选择模块，其梯度自然地以混合形式提供更丰富的训练信号——包含监督梯度分量和策略梯度分量。我们表明，随着 $m$ 的增加，选择问题变得更加困难，并且我们的算法以 $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的速率收敛，其最优上界通过在偏差和方差之间进行平衡来实现。在实践中，我们将该方法应用于一系列涉及前 $k$ 选择任务，包括合成回归问题、RAG 和 MoE 系统，结果表明我们的方法在下一词预测困惑度和问答准确率方面优于基线方法。
